description: This is a PHP source file that defines the CandidateAttachmentAPI class, which provides API endpoints for managing candidate attachments in a recruitment module. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting candidate attachments, utilizing traits and services specific to recruitment attachments.

classes.name: CandidateAttachmentAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints for managing candidate attachments, including create, get, update, and delete operations, extending the Endpoint class and implementing the CrudEndpoint interface.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception. Intended to retrieve all candidate attachments.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception. Provides validation rules for getAll method.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new candidate attachment for a specified candidate, validating input and saving the attachment.

methods.name: setCandidateAttachment
methods.description: Associates a CandidateAttachment object with a candidate ID and sets its base64 attachment data.

methods.name: setBase64Attachment
methods.description: Parses Base64 attachment data from request and sets file name, type, size, and content on CandidateAttachment object.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a candidate attachment, including entity existence and attachment format.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception. Intended to delete a candidate attachment.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception. Provides validation rules for delete method.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a candidate's attachment by candidate ID, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for getOne method.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates or deletes a candidate attachment based on input parameters, with logic to replace or delete the current attachment.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a candidate attachment, including optional attachment data and attachment type validation.

methods.name: getRecruitmentAttachment
methods.description: Converts a CandidateAttachment entity into a RecruitmentAttachment DTO for API response.
